title: About Dr. Rama Mathur
intro: Dr. Rama Mathur is a homoeopathic doctor in Jaipur with 31 years of clinical experience. She sees patients at Rajesh Homeo Home in Banipark, in Hindi and English.
She holds an M.D. (Homoeopathy) from Rajasthan University (2001), an NDDY from the Gandhi National Academy of Naturopathy (2004) and an MBA in HR (2010).
She keeps detailed clinical notes and records for each patient, refers patients to other health practitioners when appropriate, and communicates clearly with patients.
